judgment.rationale: The new user comment confirms that the regression is specifically bare-digit layout switching during an active drag and traces it to merged PR #48569. Current code intentionally requires Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit during a drag, but that same PR also added EVENT_OBJECT_DESTROY cleanup and unconditional drag-state disablement. Restoring bare digits only while a verified move/size operation is active is now a concrete compatibility design question, not merely user confusion.

actions.label: Verify FancyZones drag-only digit safety

reproduce.title: Compare drag-only digit behavior with stale-drag cleanup
prerequisites: At least two configured FancyZones layouts with quick-layout numbers
steps: Assign quick-layout digits 0-2 and open a normal application window.
Begin dragging the window with the configured FancyZones activation mode and press a bare assigned digit.
End the drag, focus a text field, and type the same digit.
Repeat while destroying the dragged window mid-drag, then type digits in another app.
reproduce.expected_result: A product-approved compatibility build may accept bare digits only during a verified active drag; digits outside or after an aborted/destroyed drag must remain untouched.

actions.note: Display-only reproduction plan; it does not post to GitHub.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore bare-digit quick layouts only for a verified active drag
proposed_fixes.root_cause: PR #48569 coupled its stale-drag safety fix with a new Win+Ctrl+Alt requirement for the drag-specific quick-layout path, removing the prior bare-digit behavior even during a valid move/size operation.
plan: Separate the global Win+Ctrl+Alt quick-layout chord from the drag-only digit shortcut in FancyZones::OnKeyDown.
Permit a bare assigned digit only when m_windowMouseSnapper exists and DraggingState confirms an active move/size operation.
Preserve EVENT_OBJECT_DESTROY, MoveSizeEnd, and AbortMoveSize cleanup so a destroyed window cannot leave digit capture active.
Add UI coverage for bare digit during a live drag, ordinary digits outside a drag, destroyed-window drag cleanup, and the existing Win+Ctrl+Alt path.
verification: During an active FancyZones drag, a configured bare digit switches layouts.
Outside an active drag, ordinary number keys are never swallowed.
Destroying the dragged window clears the state and subsequent number typing reaches the foreground app.
Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit continues to work in and out of drag.

confidence.rationale: The exact behavior-changing commit and current guard are known. Product approval is still required because the current test deliberately codifies the new chord and the safety invariant must be revalidated.
